title: Built an AI feature that saves you the 10 minutes you’d spend Googling “why did my stock drop today”
author: Emojinapp
selftext:
Briefcase is an iOS portfolio tracker I built solo, stocks, crypto, bonds, real estate, cash, all in one place. Just shipped an update today aimed squarely at a specific time-sink: checking on your portfolio and then manually digging through news to figure out why something moved.  
The old flow, for me and probably you: open the app, see a red number, open a browser, search the ticker, skim three articles, still not sure which one actually explains it. That’s 10-15 minutes for something that should take 30 seconds.  
What the update does instead:  
Every holding shows its top headlines right on your dashboard, no separate search

Tap “Why did this move?” and the agent explains today’s price action with the actual news behind it, cited

A daily brief every morning ranks your biggest movers with the news attached, so you start the day already knowing what happened overnight instead of piecing it together

The part that actually saves time isn’t the AI part, it’s that you don’t have to leave the app or open five tabs. Everything that used to take a separate research detour is now inline.  
It’s honest when it doesn’t know something too. Not every move has a clear cause, and the agent says so instead of inventing a reason, which matters if you’re going to trust it enough to skip own googling.
